resources.string: PD2 Launcher Lite plays Project Diablo 2 from your own Diablo II folder on your device, with touch and controller controls. Import a folder that already has Project Diablo 2; the official PD2 launcher keeps it up to date and starts the game.
PD2 Launcher Lite is a community-made tool. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Project Diablo 2 team or Blizzard Entertainment.
